zh.title: 美批准對伊拉克八億美元直升機軍售案
zh.summary: 美國務院批准對伊拉克八億美元直升機軍售案
body: 美國國務院已批准一項對伊拉克的擬議軍售案，內容包括貝爾412EPX與貝爾407M直升機，預估最高價值八億美元。美國國防安全合作局（DSCA）於2026年8月31日通知國會此一擬議交易。
這項擬議中的軍售案包括武裝直升機、武器、感測器、通訊設備、備用零件、訓練與後勤支援。貝爾德事隆公司（Bell Textron）將擔任主要承包商。
軍售包裹內容包括GAU-19三管機槍、M260七管火箭發射器（用於2.75吋火箭），以及L3Harris WESCAM MX-15HDI電光與紅外線感測系統。另外還包括AN/AAR-60 Block 2飛彈預警系統、VHF無線電等。
DSCA並未說明伊拉克將接收多少架貝爾412EPX或407M直升機。貝爾412EPX是雙引擎機型，設計供通用與運輸任務使用；較小的貝爾407M則是貝爾407的軍用版本，配置用於武裝偵察與輕型攻擊任務。
據美國務院表示，這項銷售案將提升伊拉克執行旋翼運輸、偵察與空對地目標瞄準任務的能力。這項採購也是伊拉克持續以美製飛機替換俄製直升機計畫的一環。
先前報導伊拉克現代化計畫中擬採購的數量並未列入本次軍售，因此本次銷售案未指明飛機數量。八億美元代表此擬議包裹的上限估計值，而非最終合約價格。
美國與伊拉克已同意由聯軍任務轉向雙邊安全關係的分階段轉型，目前階段原定於2026年9月底結束。

en.title: US approves $800M sale of Bell 412EPX, 407M helicopters to Iraq
en.summary: US State Dept approves $800M proposed Bell helicopter sale to Iraq; DSCA notified Congress.
body: The US State Department has approved a proposed $800 million Foreign Military Sale of Bell 412EPX and Bell 407M helicopters to Iraq, according to the State Department announcement.

The Defense Security Cooperation Agency (DSCA) notified Congress of the proposed transaction on August 31, 2026. The package includes armed helicopters, weapons, sensors, communications equipment, spare parts, training, and logistical support. Bell Textron will serve as the principal contractor.

The package comprises GAU-19 three-barrel machine guns and M260 seven-tube launchers for 2.75-inch rockets, along with L3Harris WESCAM MX-15HDI electro-optical and infrared sensor systems. Also included are AN/AAR-60 Block 2 missile warning systems, VHF radios, and ground support equipment.

The DSCA did not specify the number of Bell 412EPX or 407M helicopters that Iraq would receive under the proposed sale. The twin-engine Bell 412EPX is designed for utility and transport missions, while the smaller 407M is a military version of the Bell 407 configured for armed reconnaissance and light attack.

According to the State Department, the sale would improve Iraq's capability for rotary-wing transport, reconnaissance, and air-to-surface targeting missions. It is also part of Iraq's longer-term effort to replace Russian-built helicopters that are increasingly hard to maintain.

The $800 million figure represents the estimated maximum value of the proposed package, not the final contract price, and the value and equipment can change during negotiations. Earlier proposed Iraqi modernization plans to acquire Bell 412-family helicopters and Bell 407Ms are separate from this sale, which does not specify aircraft numbers.

The proposed sale comes as Iraq continues taking greater responsibility for its own security while the US-led coalition winds down operations against ISIS in the country. The US and Iraq have agreed on a phased transition toward bilateral security relationships, with the current phase scheduled to conclude by the end of September 2026.
